scope: Gemma4 31B BF16 TP1 gfx942 interpreter call-boundary traffic and direct-GEMV qualification. This is not a vLLM performance win.
sampling: Six identical dispatches per process; first three discarded, remaining three reported. Each metric group runs a fresh process, not simultaneous counters. Baseline event timings are uninstrumented; counter CSV timestamps are separate profiling observations.
counter_scope: Every counter CSV row is the exact interpreter symbol and joins its dispatch ID to matching kernel trace. hipMemset, copies, profiler helpers have other dispatch IDs and are excluded. Empty queue and NOP controls use the same object, launch grid, buffer initialization and cursor reset.
counter_units: KiB (1024 bytes), not decimal kB; external traffic is not scratch-exclusive.

FETCH_SIZE.Description: The total kilobytes fetched from the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

WRITE_SIZE.Description: The total kilobytes written to the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

finding: The general plow_exec call saves 112 VGPR dwords per lane before opcode selection. The NOP control retains about 69,331 KiB of writes while an empty queue has 9.5 KiB. A direct call to the existing inlined GEMV helper removes most of this traffic without changing projection arithmetic or queue synchronization.
final_candidate_scope: Explicit gfx942 GQ ordinary-path guards and scalarized instruction/tensor pointers. Full model uses shipping MM1 lowrung and changes only MM4 decode GQ.
model_cases: 51 steps / 107 full-vocabulary logit rows, contexts128/4096/8176, B1-B4 transitions and sparse mixed steps. All rows compared byte-for-byte against the restored shipping control.
artifact_recovery: An llvm-objcopy dump command reserialized nonallocated ELF string tables. Original shipping and rebuilt-control containers were recovered with exact original whole-file hashes; loaded sections and symbol semantics were unchanged. Both restored controls requalified all107 rows bitwise before final-model qualification.
serving_status: Complete:36 stock vllm bench serve runs,144requests/18432outputtokens;48/48 measured paired texts exact. C4 throughput improves4.30–7.56%; short median TTFT regresses12.89%. Not an all-metrics improvement.
limitations: Counter capture uses the initial candidate40546a; final-model qualification uses explicitly scoped/scalarized candidate00dd848f.
Control and candidate full-model timings come from separate bounded leases; retain all samples, including candidate69.52ms atctx4096. Its median improves but its mean regresses.
Hardware counters establish call-boundary traffic, not that bandwidth saturation, cache misses or occupancy dominate the whole model or explain the entire vLLM gap.

MM1 passes107full-logitrows bitwise with same-GPU shipping/candidate/shipping bracket; solo model medians improve17.54–18.05%. MM8 remains unqualified at full-model level and its primitive head latency regresses up to12%.

Short C4 TTFT spans191.53–430.36ms in controls and189.57–275.22ms in candidates. Per-request first-token times show differing groups; this is consistent with variable packing/admission, not proof of the cause. No runs are excluded.
